whyItIsWrong: expected_count equals (a+b)(a+c)/N exactly (7,670 × 49,486 / 13,840,535 = 27.424 for cardiac failure); the run multiplied by (c+d) instead of (a+c), got 7,665.750, and told the reader the method was unknown. It also names a field (`expected_count`) in reader prose.
